brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Build is a 2-column × 2-storey hex base assembly (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full with level 1 pieces and top covers cover:0,0,1;full;top, cover:1,0,1;full;top) braced with side-connector-double at level 0 and 1. Top covers provide flat shelf surfaces for books; meshClash is 'clear' and no error issues. Load rating to 50 kg cannot be verified by the configurator (checks fit only, not strength) so rating is not certified.

Two notch drawer frames placed: notch:0#0,1#notch1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm at 0,1,0) and notch:0#1,-1#notch4 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf at 1,-1,0), flanking the two-column base and braced by connectors.

finish.summary: Shelf unit configured as two adjacent columns 2 levels high with top covers as shelf surfaces and side connectors for bracing, plus two notch drawer frames at ground level. Fit verified (meshClash clear) but 50 kg load rating cannot be certified by the configurator — do not claim a rated capacity without physical load testing.

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
